plain_english: Now the liṅga-worship hinted in the Mālinī doctrine is told.
sanskrit_cite: athocyate liṅgapūjā sūcitā mālinīmate

plain_english: Of their higher-śāstra-told mantras: not installed; should put outside, then: these, by secrecy, are givers of siddhi.
sanskrit_cite: eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ

plain_english: Possessing the entry into the greatness of own vigor-bliss: who give siddhi — of them, externality is form-loss.
sanskrit_cite: svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ

plain_english: And what was said: Samāveśa-full, enjoyer-natured Śiva; in interruption of enjoyment-lust-enjoyment, of nature of restraint.
sanskrit_cite: kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ

plain_english: Produced from peace-surpassing-rite-hunger-increased body, itself installed, by which he in enjoyment perishes.
sanskrit_cite: śāntatvanyakkriyodbhūtajighatsāvṛṃhitaṃ vapuḥ svayaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena so@syābhoge vinaśyati

plain_english: Was said in Jñānottara, and that this by Supreme Lord: Śiva sacrifice-loving, from which especially in mothers' midst.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ

plain_english: Therefore in secret śāstras: which mantras — these the wise — outside not should install ever, especially manifest-formed.
sanskrit_cite: tasmādrahasyaśāstreṣu ye mantrāstānbudho bahiḥ na pratiṣṭhāpayejjātu viśeṣādvyaktarūpiṇaḥ

plain_english: Hence indeed for the dead's sake installation elsewhere was enjoined; that here in śāstras not to be done, to be done common again.
sanskrit_cite: ata eva mṛtasyārthe pratiṣṭhānyatra yoditā sātra śāstreṣu no kāryā kāryā sādhāraṇī punaḥ

plain_english: Up to tanmayatva-accomplishment, from desired-fruit-arising: putraka, sādhaka, manifest-unmanifest, or should resort to.
sanskrit_cite: ā tanmayatvasaṃsiddherā cābhīṣṭaphalodayāt putrakaḥ sādhako vyaktamavyaktaṃ vā samāśrayet

plain_english: By putrakas guru is to be requested; sādhaka but himself knowing: if he should install not, if then also to be requested, guru should become.
sanskrit_cite: putrakairgururabhyarthyaḥ sādhakastu svayaṃ vidan yadi tatsthāpayenno cettenāpyarthyo gururbhavet

plain_english: Guru and here in so-called nirodha: time thus in the Lord he should say; living in this until fruit-end, you should stand until life-end — or.
sanskrit_cite: guruścātra nirodhākhye kāla itthaṃ vibhau vadet jīvatyasminphalāntaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭherjīvāvadhīti vā

plain_english: Liṅga, and Bāṇa-liṅga, or gem-born, or-then pearl, flower-food-and, cloth, scent-substance-made, and or.
sanskrit_cite: liṅgaṃ ca bāṇaliṅgaṃ vā ratnajaṃ vātha mauktikam pauṣpamānnamatho vāstraṃ gandhadravyakṛtaṃ ca vā

plain_english: But not stone-born liṅga, sculptor-risen should consider; metal-risen and gold-risen-except other reject.
sanskrit_cite: natu pāṣāṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilpyutthaṃ parikalpayet dhātūtthaṃ ca suvarṇotthavarjamanyadvivarjayet

plain_english: Not and here liṅga-measure-and-the-rest anywhere is used; by noble vigor-mantras what is shone, fruit-giving, for that.
sanskrit_cite: na cātra liṅgamānādi kvacidapyupayujyate udāravīryairmantrairyadbhāsitaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat

plain_english: Of it also by altar-and-the-rest-enjoined-rite he should purify; mantra-offering likewise should be nirodha as said by reason.
sanskrit_cite: tasyāpi sthaṇḍilādyuktavidhinā śuddhimācaret mantrārpaṇaṃ tathaiva syānnirodhastūktayuktitaḥ

plain_english: In fire and tarpaṇa, by abundance especially dakṣiṇā of guru, poor-and-the-rest-satisfaction-abundance-sacrifice: thus superior rite.
sanskrit_cite: agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bhūriviśeṣāddakṣiṇā guroḥ dīnāditṛptirvibhavādyāga ityadhiko vidhiḥ

plain_english: In all unmanifest liṅgas primary should be unconstructed; so and there there-said in mark in Pārameśvara.
sanskrit_cite: sarveṣvavyaktaliṅgeṣu pradhānaṃ syādakalpitam tathā ca tatra tatroktaṃ lakṣaṇe pārameśvare

plain_english: In thread, vessel, banner, cloth, svayambhū-Bāṇa-worshipped, river-spring-risen: and no calling, nor even construction.
sanskrit_cite: sūtre pātre dhvaje vastre svayambhūbāṇapūjite nadīprasravaṇotthe ca nāhvānaṃ nāpi kalpanā

plain_english: Seat-temple-mantra-portion-time-rule, and not manifest or in painting-book-and-the-rest, god-wood-gold-born.
sanskrit_cite: pīṭhaprasādamantrāṃśavelādiniyamo naca vyaktaṃ vā citrapustādau devadārusuvarṇajam

plain_english: Now by initiated good-artisan-made installs guru, or-else mark-endowed-head-shell-supported.
sanskrit_cite: atha dīkṣitasacchilpikṛtaṃ sthāpayate guruḥ athavā lakṣaṇopetamūrdhatatkarparāśritam

plain_english: By row-chakra-triśūla-lotus-rite should resort to tūra; its mark I speak, in venerable Picu-śāstra was set forth.
sanskrit_cite: paṅkticakrakaśūlābjavidhinā tūramāśrayet tallakṣaṇaṃ bruve śrīmatpicuśāstre nirūpitam

plain_english: In tūra yoga always is praised, giver of siddhi in faultless; by nets-torn, by holes-teeth-deficient-excess disease.
sanskrit_cite: tūre yogaḥ sadā śastaḥ siddhido doṣavarjite jālakairjarjarai randhrairdantairūnādhikai rujā

plain_english: In suitable and in tūra loss would be, in its deficient sacrifice supreme; desired indeed would-be-tūra — thus some adopted.
sanskrit_cite: yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire

plain_english: Gurus but in rite, in desired, from effort reject faults — thus they explain Picu-spoken; not in obligatory rite — thus this.
sanskrit_cite: guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ

plain_english: In venerable Siddhātantra was said and tūra-mark-supreme: in one-to-four-fragment, in cow-mouth, in full-moon.
sanskrit_cite: śrīsiddhātantra uktaṃ ca tūralakṣaṇamuttamam ekādikacatuṣkhaṇḍe gomukhe pūrṇacandrake

plain_english: In lotus-go-rocanā-pearl-salt-crystal-like, in one-to-five-hundred-holes-vidyā-line-possessing, in auspicious.
sanskrit_cite: padmagorocanāmuktānīrasphaṭikasaṃnibhe ekādipañcasadrandhravidyārekhānvite śubhe

plain_english: Not in rough-crooked-fragment-long-depressed-with-bindu: by smooth, by diamond-needle here, clearly, goddess-group-possessing.
sanskrit_cite: na rūkṣavakraśakaladīrghanimnasabinduke ślakṣṇayā vajrasūcyātra sphuṭaṃ devīgaṇānvitam

plain_english: All should draw worshipful, all-limbs-beautiful; this very should follow in argha-vessel also, mark.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ samālikhetpūjyaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram etadevānusartavyamarghapātre@pi lakṣaṇam

plain_english: In venerable Brahmayāmala was said: vessel, cow-mouth-supreme, elephant-tortoise-base, pot-round-śakti-born-form.
sanskrit_cite: śrībrahmayāmale@pyuktaṃ pātraṃ gomukhamuttamam gajakūrmatalaṃ kumbhavṛttaśaktikajākṛti

plain_english: Bead-thread and should make there indeed worship sequence, hero-substance-water-born-pearl-gem-gold-born.
sanskrit_cite: akṣasūtramatho kuryāttatraivābhyarcayetkramam vīradhātujalodbhūtamuktāratnasuvarṇajam

plain_english: Bead-thread, sequence-extracted, rudrākṣa, or especially hundred, tithi-superior, or-even with-eight, or-even its-half.
sanskrit_cite: akṣasūtraṃ kramotkṛṣṭaṃ raudrākṣaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ śataṃ tithyuttaraṃ yadvā sāṣṭaṃ yadvā tadardhakam

plain_english: Its-half, or-then fifty-joined, he should consider that; mouths five, from consciousness-pulse-knowledge-will-action-union.
sanskrit_cite: tadardhaṃ vātha pañcāśadyuktaṃ tatparikalpayet vaktrāṇi pañca citspandajñānecchākṛtisaṃgateḥ

plain_english: Fivefold-end-going, unity-thus-penultimate-bead-going, rite, by śakti-and-its-division: there two-form is said.
sanskrit_cite: pañcadhādyantagaṃ caikyamityupāntyākṣago vidhiḥ śaktitadvatprabhedena tatra dvairūpyamucyate

plain_english: Then in double-measure but two-formed nyāsa he should perform; then even in double, by creation-dissolution-pair, him.
sanskrit_cite: tato dviguṇamāne tu dvirūpaṃ nyāsamācaret tato@pi dviguṇe sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtidvitayena tam

plain_english: Mātṛkā, Mālinī, or-then: he should place in ether-sixteen-measured; in supreme but two, having-placed-having-placed, before impelled-ones.
sanskrit_cite: mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha nyasyetkhaśarasaṃmite uttame tu dvayīṃ nyasyennyasya pūrvaṃ pracoditān

plain_english: In initiation primarily mantras those fifteen, the daiśika; if or by tattva-bhuvana-kalā-mantra-pada-phoneme.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣāyāṃ mukhyato mantrāṃstānpañcadaśa daiśikaḥ yadi vā tattvabhuvanakalāmantrapadārṇajaiḥ

plain_english: By number-differences in made in thread: him him nyāsa guru should perform; having-made bead-thread, of it also all should be as altar.
sanskrit_cite: saṃkhyābhedaiḥ kṛte sūtre taṃ taṃ nyāsaṃ guruścaret kṛtvākṣasūtraṃ tasyāpi sarvaṃ sthaṇḍilavadbhavet

plain_english: By worshipped and by that very japa should perform undistracted: rite said this in venerable Mālinīvijayottara.
sanskrit_cite: pūjitena ca tenaiva japaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ vidhiruktastvayaṃ śrīmanmālinīvijayottare

plain_english: Wheel-like-whirling-this-what-he-says: he japa would be; if he sees, he offers this in awakening-fire, from entering.
sanskrit_cite: cakravadbhramayannetadyadvakti sa japo bhavet yadīkṣate juhotyetadbodhāgnau saṃpraveśanāt

plain_english: Or argha-great-vessel should make that supreme param; coconut-and, bilva, golden, silver, and or.
sanskrit_cite: athavārghamahāpātraṃ kuryāttaccottaraṃ param nārikelamatho bailvaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā

plain_english: Of it also this rite all in installation-beginning was declared; by its unshaking fluids full, having made in this worship sequence.
sanskrit_cite: tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pratiṣṭhādau prakīrtitaḥ tanniṣkamparasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvāsminpūjayetkramam

plain_english: Downward-faced always to be placed; worshipped in worship again, that vessel upward-faced; and that empty should make not, such.
sanskrit_cite: adhomukhaṃ sadā sthāpyaṃ pūjitaṃ pūjane punaḥ tatpātramunmukhaṃ tacca riktaṃ kuryānna tādṛśam

plain_english: At worship-end, that-fluid-full-self having disposed, that downward-faced and having fully worshipped, he should place, the wise.
sanskrit_cite: pūjānte tadrasāpūrṇamātmānaṃ pravidhāya tat adhomukhaṃ ca saṃpūjya sthāpayet vicakṣaṇaḥ

plain_english: Sword, dagger, or-even scissors, mirror, and or, pure, so-thus should make as venerable Kālī-mouth spoken.
sanskrit_cite: khaṅgaṃ kṛpāṇikāṃ yadvā kartarīṃ makuraṃ ca vā vimalaṃ tattathā kuryācchrīmatkālīmukhoditam

plain_english: In venerable Bhairavakula was said in Kula-festival-pre-worship: on altar-in-fire, on cloth, on liṅga, on vessel, on lotus-then, on maṇḍala.
sanskrit_cite: śrībhairavakule@pyuktaṃ kulaparvaprapūjane sthaṇḍile@gnau paṭe liṅge pātre padme@tha maṇḍale

plain_english: On image, on pot-in-heap, on brick, on thread-then: should worship by own, by own service; mixture should reject — thus.
sanskrit_cite: mūrtau ghaṭe@strasaṃghāte dhaṭe sūtre@tha pūjayet svena svenopacāreṇa saṅkaraṃ varjayediti

plain_english: As in waters for peace, mantras so in weapons and the rest certainly; enemy-cutting-and-the-rest-doers, desired from, mixture abandoned.
sanskrit_cite: yathāpsu śāntaye mantrāstadvadastrādiṣu dhruvam śatrucchedādikartāraḥ kāmyo@taḥ saṅkarojjhitaḥ

plain_english: Of the desireless but they, from that-that-place-condition-power certainly: fetter-cutting-purified-tattva-nourishing-and-the-rest-doers.
sanskrit_cite: akāmasya tu te tattatsthānopādhivaśāddhruvam pāśakartanasaṃśuddhatattvāpyāyādikāriṇaḥ

plain_english: Or-else book, such-seizing-śāstra-sequence-possessing, well-purified, by-initiated-made: there also this rite is remembered.
sanskrit_cite: athavā pustakaṃ tādṛgrahaḥśāstrakramombhitam suśuddhaṃ dīkṣitakṛtaṃ tatrāpyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ

plain_english: Thus in self-installations, as long as standing is: by abundance tarpaṇa, purity so long interruption-avoidance.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ svayaṃpratiṣṭheṣu yāvadyāvatsthitirbhavet vibhavaistarpaṇaṃ śuddhistāvadvicchedavarjanam

plain_english: Hence indeed when many-days maṇḍala-construction: then in-day in-day should perform by abundance tarpaṇa, much.
sanskrit_cite: ata eva yadā bhūridinaṃ maṇḍalakalpanam tadā dine dine kuryādvibhavaistarpaṇaṃ bahu

plain_english: In installation and everywhere guru, aforesaid supreme, having sought true reality, presence he should make clear.
sanskrit_cite: pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca sarvatra guruḥ pūrvoditaṃ param satattvamanusandhāya saṃnidhiṃ sphuṭamācaret

plain_english: In accomplished but in tanmayatva-state in fruit, by putraka-sādhakas to another, from that pair to either, that is offered.
sanskrit_cite: siddhe tu tanmayībhāve phale putrakasādhakaiḥ anyasmai taddvayādanyatarasmai tatsamarpyate

plain_english: Of it also this rite all in its absence but in every way: in deep water it to be cast, having asked pardon, having dismissed, and.
sanskrit_cite: tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvastadalābhe tu sarvathā agādhe@mbhasi tatkṣepyaṃ kṣamayitvā visṛjya ca

plain_english: Thus this self-installation-rite, Śiva-set-forth: in other-installed in liṅga, in Bāṇa-then, in svayambhū.
sanskrit_cite: ityeṣa svapratiṣṭhānavidhiḥ śivanirūpitaḥ parapratiṣṭhite liṅge bāṇīye@tha svayaṃbhuvi

plain_english: In all-asana-side, having placed before, should worship sequence: pure-impure-adhva-ones, all mantras, all Śiva-ending.
sanskrit_cite: sarvamāsanapakṣe prāṅnyasya saṃpūjayetkramam śuddhāśuddhādhvajāḥ sarve mantrāḥ sarvaḥ śivāntakaḥ

plain_english: Adhva and here in seat was said that everywhere worship this; invocation-dismissal but there as before should perform.
sanskrit_cite: adhvā cehāsane proktastatsarvatrārcayedidam āvāhanavisṛṣṭī tu tatra prāgvatsamācaret

plain_english: Was said in tantra also Aghoreśa, in Svacchanda, by Lord; so or-else daily as said by half-half-portion-appointment.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ tantre@pyaghoreśe svacchande vibhunā tathā athavā pratyahaṃ proktamānārdhārdhaniyogataḥ

plain_english: Having made desired maṇḍala there, all sequence should worship, of much kind different, liṅga-worship was set forth.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtveṣṭaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra samastaṃ kramamarcayet bahuprakārabhinnasya liṅgasyārcā nirūpitā
